prompt.project_info: Create a natural handheld winter contrast portrait of an adult woman in swimwear against a snowy alpine landscape.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fair-skinned woman with long reddish-brown hair, visible freckles, a dark ink tattoo on the left shoulder-blade/rib area, and a small non-graphic mole. She wears a black string bikini, fluffy beige earmuffs, stacked gold and black bracelets, and bright red nail polish. Preserve natural skin texture without airbrushing.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing with back to camera, torso turned left, looking over the left shoulder toward the viewer. Left hand touches the earmuff/top of head and right arm rests down. Medium-long knees-up frame, centered, with flat white snow, evergreen pines, a wooden chalet, steep snow-capped mountain, and overcast sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Flat diffuse overcast daylight, low-to-medium contrast, muted snow highlights, cool outdoor tones and slight blue cast in shadows, candid winter-vacation contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical, handheld snapshot, sharp face focus, background clear but slightly less defined, standard digital photography with natural noise and no beautification filters.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Natural handheld 9:16 snapshot of an adult fair-skinned woman with long reddish-brown hair, visible freckles, a small non-graphic mole, and a dark ink tattoo on her left shoulder-blade area. She wears a black string bikini, oversized fluffy beige earmuffs, stacked gold and black bracelets, and bright red nail polish. Standing with her back to the camera and torso twisted left, she looks over her left shoulder toward the viewer; her left hand touches the top of her head/earmuff and her right arm rests down. Set her in snowy alpine mountains with flat white snow, dark evergreen pines, a traditional wooden chalet, a steep snow-capped peak with exposed grey rock, and an overcast white-grey sky. Flat diffuse daylight, cool tones, low-to-medium contrast, natural skin texture, handheld candid composition, sharp face focus, standard digital-photography realism.
